auditor.headline: Head of internal audit, regulated financial services

Certifications shrink to a line; committee, regulator, budget and coverage take the space.

lawyer.headline: Newly qualified solicitor, admitted 2025
lawyer.why: A newly qualified CV is read for the seats you sat and the department you qualified into, because that is the whole of your practice-area evidence. State the admission jurisdiction and date rather than a roll number, list the seats with what you actually ran, and keep a short matters list — even at this level the matter, not the month, is the unit of legal experience.

lawyer.headline: Five years PQE, commercial disputes
lawyer.why: In private practice the matters list is the CV, and litigation adds detail no other field carries: the court or tribunal, the value, who you acted for and how it ended. PQE belongs in the first line because it sets the band the role is advertised at, and rights of audience are worth a line of their own — they change what a partner can staff you on.

lawyer.headline: General counsel, dual-qualified, fifteen years
lawyer.why: Going in house changes what a legal CV proves. Matters give way to the risks you own, the budget you control and the board you advise — and dual qualification must appear as two separate admissions with their dates, because a jurisdiction is not a skill that can be implied from the work.
